what.label: What is Yoyo
what.statement: Yoyo is a rental marketplace between people. Take what you need for as long as you need it, share what you rarely use, and everything finds its way back.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.lead: Renting on Yoyo takes a few clear steps, and both sides always see which step a deal is at and what comes next.

find.title: Find the item
find.body: Search by what you need and where. Each listing shows the price per day, the deposit, the owner's rules and the days it is free.

request.title: Send a request
request.body: Pick whole days and send a request, with a message if you like. The owner has {requestHours} hours to accept; after that the request expires and nothing is charged.

contract.title: Sign the contract
contract.body: Yoyo prepares a rental contract with both names, the item, the dates, the price, the deposit and the rules. You both sign it before any payment.

pay.title: Pay the rent and the deposit
pay.body: You pay the rent plus a {fee}% service fee. The deposit is frozen for the rental, not handed to the owner.

handover.title: Meet and take it
handover.body: Agree on a time and place in the chat. When you take the item, you both mark the handover.

return.title: Bring it back
return.body: Return it by the last day and you both mark the return. Once the owner confirms all is well, the whole deposit comes back to you.

list.title: Create a listing
list.body: Add photos, a title, the category, a price per day, an optional discount from 7 days, a deposit and your rules. Only the district is shown publicly, never your address.

review.title: Wait for the check
review.body: A person reviews every new listing. If something needs fixing, you get the reason and can correct it.

accept.title: Answer requests
accept.body: You see who is asking and for which days. Accept within {requestHours} hours, or decline.

handover.title: Hand it over
handover.body: Meet the renter, photograph the item's condition and mark the handover. The rent is yours once the handover is confirmed.

check.title: Check it when it is back
check.body: You have {checkHours} hours to press “All good” or report damage with a description and photos. If you do nothing, the item counts as fine.

deposit.heading: The deposit rule
deposit.lead: The deposit follows one rule, the same for everyone:
deposit.fine: All good: the whole deposit goes back to the renter.
deposit.agreed: Damage, and the renter agrees: the whole deposit goes to the owner.
deposit.disputed: Damage, and the renter disagrees: our team looks at the photos from the handover and the return, the chat and the history of the deal, and decides who gets the deposit.
deposit.timeouts: So that no deposit gets stuck: if the owner does not check the item within {checkHours} hours, it counts as fine, and if the renter does not answer a damage report within {checkHours} hours, our team takes it over.
deposit.notReturned: If an item is not returned after the last day, the owner can open a dispute and our team takes it from there.

cancel.heading: Changing your mind
cancel.body: Either side can cancel a deal until the item is handed over. If it was already paid, the renter gets back the rent, the fee and the deposit. After the handover there is no cancelling: the item is returned and the deal closes as usual.

reviews.heading: Reviews
reviews.body: When a deal closes, both sides have {reviewDays} days to rate each other from 1 to 5 stars and write a few words. The renter also rates the item. Only real deals can be reviewed.

today.heading: Where Yoyo is today
today.body: We are opening Yoyo step by step, so some of these steps arrive on the site later than others. Until online payment is live, no money moves through Yoyo, and the deal screen will always say so plainly.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.lead: Short, honest answers. If yours is not here, write to us.

who.a: Anyone aged 18 or over with a confirmed email address. One account works both ways: you can rent and lend from the same profile.

days.q: Can I rent something for a few hours?
days.a: No, rentals count in whole days. You pick the first and the last day, and both count.

meet.q: How do I get the item?
meet.a: You meet the owner in person, at a time and place you agree on in the chat. Yoyo does not deliver. Only the owner's district is public; the exact spot is up to the two of you.

longer.q: What if I need it for longer?
longer.a: Ask the owner in the chat before the last day. Extra days are a new request, so the calendar stays right for everyone.

what.a: Things you own, or are allowed to rent out, that are safe and legal to use. Weapons, illegal, stolen or counterfeit goods, hazardous substances and animals are not allowed. The full list is in the terms of service.

price.q: How do I choose the price and the deposit?
price.a: You set both. A fair price per day is usually a small part of what the item costs new. The deposit should cover a repair or a replacement if something goes wrong.

hidden.q: Why is my listing not visible yet?
hidden.a: A person checks every new listing before it appears. If something needs changing, you get the reason and can fix it.

decline.q: Do I have to accept every request?
decline.a: No. You decide who rents your things. A request you do not answer within 24 hours simply expires.

cost.a: Creating an account and listing items is free. When online payments are live, the renter pays a 10% service fee on top of the rent. Owners pay no fee.

payNow.q: Can I already pay through Yoyo?
payNow.a: Not yet. We are opening Yoyo step by step, and online payment comes together with bookings. Until then no money moves through Yoyo, and we never ask you for card details.

deposit.a: It is frozen for the rental and not paid to the owner. If all is well, it comes back to the renter in full. If there is damage and the renter agrees, it goes to the owner; if not, our team decides.

paid.q: When does the owner get paid?
paid.a: As soon as both sides confirm the handover. The service fee goes to Yoyo at the same moment.

broken.a: Tell the owner straight away in the chat. When it is back, the owner can report damage with photos, and the deposit rule decides what happens. If you disagree, our team looks at the photos, the chat and the deal history and decides.

notReturned.q: What if the item is not returned?
notReturned.a: After the last day the owner can open a dispute. Our team looks at the deal and decides about the deposit. In the case of theft, also contact the police.

report.q: How do I report a listing or a person?
report.a: Write to admin@yoyo.rent with a link and a few words about what happened. We read every message. Report buttons on listings, messages and profiles are on the way.

insurance.a: No, Yoyo does not offer insurance. The deposit is the protection, so set it high enough to cover a repair or a replacement.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: Open Settings, then Security, then Delete account. Your name, email, phone, sessions and unpublished listings are removed at once; published listings are taken down. If you have an open deal or money in your Yoyo wallet, finish the deal or pay the money out first. The privacy policy has the details.

data.q: What do you do with my data?
data.a: Only what the service needs to work. No advertising, no tracking, no selling of data. The privacy policy lists what we keep, why and for how long.

language.q: Can I use Yoyo in Latvian or Russian?
language.a: Yes. The whole site works in English, Latvian and Russian; switch at the top or the bottom of any page. Emails come in the language of your account.

contact.a: Write to admin@yoyo.rent. A real person reads every message.
